global_options.description: Global Caddy options (e.g., `auto_https off`, `metrics`, `admin { ... }`). One directive per line.

sites.description: List of virtual hosts (sites) to serve.

address.description: Site address — domain, IP, or `:port`. May include scheme (`http://`, `https://`) or port-only (`:443`).

routes.description: List of route blocks. Each has an optional matcher and one or more handlers (directives).

matcher.description: Route matcher (e.g., `path /api/*`, `method GET`, `host api.example.com`). Empty means default route.

handlers.description: Handler directives to execute for this route (e.g., `rewrite * /index.html`, `reverse_proxy localhost:3000`).

site_directives.description: Top-level directives for the site block (outside route blocks). E.g., `encode gzip zstd`, `log { ... }`.
